recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man sitting on a piece of driftwood on a sandy lakeshore, framed by overhanging green leaves at the top and a calm body of water with a pontoon boat in the background, featuring a two-tier typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Overhanging foliage acting as a natural top border
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the image behind the subject
Text layers floating in the negative space of the bright sky
coreInvariants: High-key sky with minimal cloud detail
Natural textures of sand, wood, and water

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot of a seated man, occupying the lower-middle vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark, textured driftwood log he sits on.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large gold text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows his posture down to the shoreline and background boat.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open area in the upper half consisting of a pale, bright sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (sand and sky) providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue and green (water and leaves) providing natural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden ochre and bright teal (typography) for brand recognition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High brightness with moderate saturation; shadows are warm rather than black.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and aquatic tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, geometric uppercase letters with consistent stroke weight.
Secondary text uses a handwritten, marker-style script with irregular baselines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide spacing between characters in the primary title
Interlocking or overlapping feel in the script subtitle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, formal geometric sans and a loose, energetic organic script.

preserve: Wide tracking on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, wide geometric uppercase look for the primary title.
Captures the casual, hand-drawn energy of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a man with styled hair and a beard, wearing a patterned short-sleeve shirt and ripped jeans, sitting on a dark driftwood log on a sandy beach. In the background, a calm blue lake with a white pontoon boat and green hills. Frame the top with overhanging green tree leaves. Use warm, bright summer lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a wide-tracked, golden-ochre geometric sans-serif font in the upper sky area. Below it, center a secondary title in a bright teal, marker-style handwritten script.

verificationChecks: Is the man centered and sitting on a log?
Are the leaves framing the top edge?
Is the text color-coded gold and teal?
Is the sky bright and mostly clear?

adjustableVariables: Specific pattern on the subject's shirt
Exact shade of the teal accent
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any visible brand logos on the boat or clothing
Exact letterforms of the handwritten script

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of text against the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the leaves or the subject's head.
Ensure the horizon line is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the lighting on the subject matches the bright sky.
Confirm the two fonts have distinct personalities (geometric vs script).
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Subject + Natural Framing (Top) + High-Key Sky + Two-Tone Geometric/Script Typography Overlay
